signal_conditioning.prohibited_assumption: Do not budget a bare common 5 V HX711 board as proven compatible with the CAS 10 V excited bridge.
signal_conditioning.analysis: A normally grounded balanced bridge excited at 10 V has about 5 V common-mode output. HX711 input common mode is AGND+1.2 to AVDD-1.3 V (3.7 V maximum at AVDD=5 V), so direct connection exceeds it. CAS nominal full-scale differential output is 30 mV at 10 V; HX711 gain128 at AVDD5 V is only about +/-20 mV.
acceptable_architecture_candidates: 10 V low-noise bridge excitation plus compatible instrumentation amplifier/ADC with proper reference/common-mode design
Vendor bridge indicator/conditioner with verified input mV/V and excitation, plus logged calibrated output
signal_conditioning.lower_excitation_note: Exciting SBA at 5 V might be calibrated experimentally, but it is outside the stated recommended 10 V condition; do not transfer manufacturer performance class without confirmation.
required_validation: Actual excitation and ADC common-mode/headroom check
Zero/span and force-range calibration in tensile direction
Noise and acquisition bandwidth suitable for the selected speed/material
signal_conditioning.budget_status: KRW 200000-400000 unquoted allowance in each scenario; actual suitable component/indicator not selected.

support_ratings.warning: Specific NTN-SNR C5 products, not generic marketplace BK/FK names. C0a and complete-unit static axial capacity are distinct.
support_ratings.interpretation: BK12 and FK12 fail even ideal 5 kN per-axis balanced load. BK20/FK20 exceed 5 kN nominal only narrowly and fail this project >=10 kN-per-end criterion. BK35 is merely a rating example, not selected or a fit on SFU1605 journals.

custom_thrust_candidate.concept: Opposed thrust bearings for bidirectional restraint plus separate radial support, precision carrier, controlled preload/clearance and checked journal/locknut/shoulder.
custom_thrust_candidate.not_drop_in: 16 mm screw body alone is smaller than 20 mm minimum shaft abutment. A properly designed hardened backing spacer/shoulder and complete load-path verification are necessary. Bearing C0a does not certify custom support.

drive.interpretation: Direct 2 Nm or 3 Nm NEMA23 cannot produce required 4.42 Nm/axis even at holding torque. 3:1 is a preliminary torque candidate only; running torque and speed/current, belt ratings, synchronization and screw/nut/end machining remain unverified.
drive.status: UNSELECTED reduction and end supports. No 10 kN operating claim.

grip_layout.formula: F_hold = 2 * mu * Q where Q is clamp resultant and normal on EACH specimen face
grip_layout.warning: Q is not the sum of both face normal loads. Assumed friction, equal bolt sharing, specimen crushing/notching and preload are unverified. 15 kN is a design screening load case, not an instruction to proof-load an unverified fixture.
grip_layout.fabrication_price_status: Unquoted allowance only; no machining quote obtained.

selection_gates: Confirm tensile load configuration and end attachment rated at selected stroke
Input torque curve versus load; buckling/anti-rotation and stroke geometry
Handwheel included price, freight and delivered tax
Loaded measured speed control and independent travel feedback for any standard testing claim
manual_jack.manual_limit: Hand turning alone does not establish constant test speed. Use only non-standard strength screening until required rate is controlled and verified.
manual_jack.motor12v_status: Unselected ratio and load curve; advertised low-speed range is not proof of jack torque or constant speed. Feedback/driver/supply/coupling/mount included only as an unquoted add-on allowance.

reduced_coupon_alternative.status: Future conditional smaller-standard-specimen investigation, not the same full-size A1 result. Current standard, FFF applicability, fibre/road orientation, gripping and measurement must be checked. Modulus still needs gauge-length strain measurement.

budgets.included: Primary metal frame, metal grips, guard, force electronics, actual travel measurement, basic validation, freight/tax reserves.
budgets.excluded: Owned printer/PC, user labor, accredited force/extension calibration, high-accuracy gauge-length extensometer, formal standards certification.
budgets.uncertainty: Ranges are engineering planning allowances, not supplier quotations and not proof of feasibility. Actual delivery/configuration can exceed upper bound.
budgets.budget_conclusion: Even advertised jack+cell alone consume approximately 314000-480000 before frame/grips/guard/DAQ/adapters/delivery. No verified all-in <=500000 solution established.
